newsitem.title: THAILAND: List of 42 suspended Thai finance companies. [CORRECTED 10:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: List of 42 suspended Thai finance companies. [CORRECTED 10:10 GMT]

text.p: Bank of Thailand Governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi suspended operations of 42 ailing finance companies on Tuesday.
Creditors and depositors are to be protected, he said.
1. Chao Phaya Finance and Securities Co Ltd
2. Sri Dhana Finance and Securities Plc
4. Thanapol Finance and Securities Co Ltd
5. Thai Rung Reung Finance & Securities Co Ltd
8. Krung Thai Finance and Securities Plc
10. Thai Finance and Securities Co Ltd
11. Wall Street Finance and Securities Plc
12. Siam City Credit Finance and Securities Plc
13. Premier Finance and Securities Co Ltd
17. Lila Finance and Securities Co Ltd
19. Siam City Syndicate Finance and Securities Co Ltd
21. Ekkapat Finance and Securities Co Ltd
(corrects name of suspended company from Bangkok First Investment
& Trust Ltd to clarify that Bangkok First Investment & Trust Ltd
25. Bara Development Finance and Securities Co Ltd
28. Inter Credit and Trust Co Ltd
30. First Bangkok City Finance and Securities Co Ltd
32. Thanasap Finance and Securities Co Ltd
35. Metropolis Trust and Securities Co Ltd.
38. Thana Nakorn Finance and Securities Plc
41. Cathay Trust Co Ltd (Corrects from Cathay Finance and Securities Plc which is already listed as number 6)
